_methodology.note: Prices were sourced in EUR (rate 0.86) or USD (rate 0.79) and converted to GBP at these fixed placeholder rates so they total cleanly against the flight/Airbnb figures, which are already in GBP. Re-convert at the live rate before using this for a real pitch. sourced: true = found a specific current price; sourced: false = estimated from comparable tours — verify before pitch.

activities.name: Bosphorus sightseeing cruise
activities.description: Sail between two continents past Dolmabahçe Palace, Ortaköy Mosque and the Bosphorus Bridge. Public ferry is the budget option; private sightseeing boats add a live guide.

activities.name: Hagia Sophia
activities.description: Byzantine cathedral turned mosque turned museum turned mosque again — 1,500 years of architectural history in one building.

activities.name: Topkapi Palace (incl. Harem)
activities.description: Ottoman sultans' residence for 400 years — courtyards, treasury, and the Harem quarters. Closed Tuesdays.

activities.name: Basilica Cistern
activities.description: 6th-century underground reservoir with 336 columns, including the famous upside-down Medusa heads.

activities.name: Blue Mosque (Sultan Ahmed Mosque)
activities.description: Six minarets and a cascade of domes front the working mosque famous for its 20,000 handmade İznik tiles inside. Free to enter outside prayer times; modest dress required, headscarves provided for women.

activities.name: Grand Bazaar
activities.description: One of the world's oldest and largest covered markets — over 4,000 shops across 61 streets selling carpets, lanterns, ceramics, spices and gold. Haggling is expected.

activities.name: Istanbul Archaeology Museums
activities.description: Three museums in one complex holding the Alexander Sarcophagus and treasures spanning the ancient Near East — one of the world's great archaeology collections, and usually far quieter than Topkapı next door.

activities.name: Dolmabahçe Palace
activities.description: Ottoman sultans swapped Topkapı for this 19th-century Bosphorus-front palace — crystal staircases, a 4.5-tonne chandelier, and the room where Atatürk died in 1938 (the clocks inside are stopped at 9:05, his time of death).

activities.name: Istanbul street food tour
activities.description: A guided crawl through Istanbul's food scene: fresh-baked simit, döner and kebab stalls, meze spreads, balık ekmek (grilled fish sandwiches by the Galata Bridge), a full Turkish breakfast with çay, and baklava to finish.

activities.name: Hair Transplant (FUE)
activities.description: Not a bit — Istanbul genuinely performs more hair transplants than anywhere else on earth, with entire hotel packages built around it. You'll spot the tell-tale headband bandage on roughly one in three men at the airport. Optional group activity; recovery time may exceed the length of the trip.
activities.priceRange: 1500-4000, often bundled with hotel + airport transfer as an 'all-inclusive package'
activities.sourceNote: Ballpark from general market knowledge of Istanbul hair transplant tourism pricing — not a specific clinic quote, and deliberately not meant to be taken as a real budget line.

activities.name: Hot-air balloon flight
activities.description: Dawn flight over fairy chimneys and valleys — the single most-photographed thing to do in Turkey. Weather-dependent; don't book on your last morning. Groups of 8 often get a 10-15% discount.

activities.name: Underground city + valleys guided tour
activities.description: Derinkuyu or Kaymaklı underground city plus Selime and valley viewpoints — sights are spread out, worth a driver/guide over DIY.

activities.name: Göreme Open-Air Museum
activities.description: UNESCO site of rock-cut churches with Byzantine frescoes, walkable from central Göreme.

activities.name: Rose Valley sunset hike
activities.description: A guided 2-hour walk through Güllüdere (Rose Valley), named for the rock's rose-pink glow at sunset — past rock-cut Byzantine churches and pigeon houses to a ridge viewpoint over the valley.

activities.name: Zeugma Mosaic Museum
activities.description: World's largest mosaic museum, home to the famous 'Gypsy Girl' — Roman mosaics rescued from the Zeugma site before it was flooded by a dam.

activities.name: Food tour / baklava & kebab crawl
activities.description: Gaziantep is UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy — a guided food tour through the copper bazaar and baklava houses is the best way to do the region justice.

activities.name: Pamukkale travertines + Hierapolis ruins
activities.description: Combined ticket covers the white calcium terraces, the Roman ruins of Hierapolis (theatre, necropolis), and the on-site archaeology museum.

activities.name: Cleopatra's Antique Pool
activities.description: Swim among submerged Roman columns in a warm mineral pool — optional add-on to the main ticket.

activities.name: Ephesus ancient city
activities.description: One of the best-preserved Roman cities anywhere — Library of Celsus, the Great Theatre, marble streets. Go early to beat the heat and tour groups.

activities.name: House of the Virgin Mary
activities.description: Small stone chapel in the hills above Ephesus, believed to be where Mary spent her final years — a quiet, contemplative stop.

activities.name: Full-day peninsula boat trip
activities.description: Classic Bodrum day out — cruise between turquoise bays, swim/snorkel stops, lunch on board. Standard group boats take ~40 people; smaller gulet options cost more for a quieter day.

activities.name: Bodrum Castle & Museum of Underwater Archaeology
activities.description: 15th-century Crusader castle housing shipwreck artefacts recovered from the Aegean, including the Uluburun shipwreck finds.

activities.name: Perge, Aspendos & Side day tour
activities.description: Full-day loop covering the Perge ruins, the extraordinarily preserved Aspendos Roman theatre (still used for opera), and the coastal ruins at Side. Usually includes lunch and hotel transfers.

activities.name: Termessos ruins + Düden Waterfalls
activities.description: Mountaintop Pisidian ruins (never conquered by Alexander the Great) with a hike required to reach them, paired with a stop at Düden Waterfalls on the way back.

activities.name: Kaleiçi old town walk (self-guided)
activities.description: Roman harbour, Hadrian's Gate, the fluted minaret — free to wander, easily fills half a day.
